About
ClarityCheck

ClarityCheck is a reverse lookup platform covering phone numbers, email addresses, VINs, people searches and business entities — helping users identify unknown callers, verify contacts, and research anyone or anything in seconds.

We aggregate publicly available records and open-source intelligence into clear, structured reports that anyone can read in seconds.

Our mission

We believe public information should be genuinely accessible. Official registries, court records, and open-source data exist to inform the public — but most of it is scattered, inconsistent, and hard to use. Our mission is to bring that information together in one place so people can make better everyday decisions.

What we do

Five lookup services in one platform

ClarityCheck offers five lookup services, each drawing on public records and OSINT sources. Reports are delivered in seconds and saved to your account so you can return to them later.

How our data works

Public records, organized for humans

ClarityCheck does not own private databases or collect information from users' devices. We aggregate data from publicly available sources — government registries, court records, corporate filings, public social media, and licensed OSINT vendors — and organize it into readable reports.

Our databases are refreshed daily for near-current accuracy, but results are not real time. Some records may be incomplete or outdated depending on the source jurisdiction. We cover 98.4% of North American records and 95% of European records, with global coverage at varying completion rates.

Usage Restrictions

What ClarityCheck is not

ClarityCheck is designed for personal informational purposes. To be clear about what we are not:

✕We are not a consumer reporting agency as defined by the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA).
✕Our reports must not be used for employment, tenancy, credit, insurance, or other eligibility decisions.
✕We do not offer real-time location, GPS, device monitoring, or access to private accounts or communications.
✕Our services must not be used to stalk, harass, dox, or monitor any person.

See our Terms & Conditions for full details.
